1.explanation:
• DataTable/README.md explains the component’s API and behavior around selection and filtering.
• DataTable/state/useSelectAll.js contains the logic for the “Select All” checkbox and needs inspection to adjust selection scope.
• DataTable/state/useFilterRows.js (or similar) implements row filtering, which must interact correctly with selection.
• DataTable/stories/DataTableBatchActions.story.js demonstrates the batch‐actions example (filter + select), making it easy to reproduce the bug.
• ToolbarSearch/ToolbarSearch.js provides the search toolbar code that filters the table’s rows.
• Checkbox/Checkbox.js implements the header checkbox component used for “Select All,” ensuring its change handler integrates with the table’s filtered state.
1.bug_scenario: When a user types a filter term into the DataTable’s search toolbar, the table shows only the matching rows. However, clicking the header “Select All” checkbox still selects every row in the full data set rather than just the currently visible (filtered) rows. The expectation is that only the filtered rows would be selected; instead all rows become checked.
